facts.fact: The pilot phase of national biometric enrolment, issuing a free lifelong unique identifier (NIU), began on 27 January 2026 in Atsimondrano district, with national rollout planned for April to June 2026, financed by the World Bank's PRODIGY project.
Officials say fingerprint, facial and iris capture in the enrolment is meant to guarantee uniqueness of data and end duplicates in citizen identification.
